method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 泪水浸湿她的睫毛并顺着脸颊滚落。
facts.anchor: Tears wet her eyelashes and roll hotly down her cheeks.
Hattie sniffles and swipes at her face.

facts.fact: Hattie 设想若当初和 Tommy 谈那首诗、不放手、给他治疗，本可救下一些人。
facts.anchor: If she had spoken to Tommy about the poem, hadn’t let it go, gotten him treatment of some kind, lives might’ve been saved.

facts.fact: Hattie 被爱的否认蒙蔽过，如今不会再犯同样的错。
facts.anchor: But she’d been blinded by love’s denial, and she won’t make that mistake again.

facts.fact: Hattie 在椅子里坐得更深，把梦当作潜意识的警告。
facts.anchor: Hattie settles deeper into the chair. The dream was a warning—her subconscious yelling at the top of its lungs

facts.fact: 尽管 Tommy 和其子非同一人，Hattie 对 Julian 沾染黑暗冲动的恐惧与日俱增。
facts.anchor: Tommy and his son aren’t the same person, but the fear Julian’s stained by dark impulses is becoming sharper inside her

facts.fact: 一阵最后的战栗想钻过她身体，但她太疲惫、太暖和，炉火令人平静。
facts.anchor: A final shudder tries worming its way through her but she’s too exhausted and warm and the fire is very soothing.

facts.fact: 她隐约觉得自己其实正要睡着，却不知不觉被卷走。
facts.anchor: She has an inkling that she might actually be falling asleep, but then that’s also lost in an undertow so strong she doesn’t know it’s taking her until she’s gone.
This time there are no dreams.
